llms.body:
# Twingate
> Twingate is a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platform that replaces
> traditional VPNs with identity-based access for users, services, and
> AI agents. It deploys in minutes, scales to every resource, and
> provides granular security controls without impacting performance.
> Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA.

## Company
- Customers include Blend, Modern Health, H2O.ai, Hi-Rez Studios, and Zappi
- Remote-first company with distributed teams around the world

## Product
- [Zero Trust Network Access](https://www.twingate.com/product/ztna): Core ZTNA product — secure remote access built for the modern workforce with direct-to-resource connectivity
- [Least Privilege Automation](https://www.twingate.com/product/least-privilege-automation): Automated granular access controls with context-based policies, expiration rules, and full auditability
- [Internet Security](https://www.twingate.com/product/internet-security): DNS-based internet traffic protection across all environments
- [Privileged Access Management](https://www.twingate.com/product/privileged-access-management): Replaces static SSH keys, kubeconfigs, and standing admin rights with short-lived, audited access to infrastructure, without changing how engineers work
- [Pricing](https://www.twingate.com/pricing): Starter (free, up to 5 users and 50 resources), Teams ($5/user/mo, up to 100 users), Business ($10/user/mo, up to 500 users), Enterprise (custom). 15% discount billed yearly. Home plan is $15/mo flat for non-commercial homelab use.

## Use Cases
- [VPN Replacement](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/vpn-replacement): Replace legacy VPNs with zero trust access
- [Infrastructure Access](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/infrastructure-access): Secure access to cloud and on-premise infrastructure
- [Kubernetes](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/kubernetes): Secure Kubernetes cluster access
- [DNS Filtering](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/dns-filtering): DNS-level content and threat filtering
- [Device Controls](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/device-controls): Device posture-based access policies
- [Gaming](https://www.twingate.com/use-case/gaming): Secure access for gaming studios

## Comparisons
- [Twingate vs Tailscale](https://www.twingate.com/compare/tailscale): Side-by-side comparison
- [Twingate vs OpenVPN](https://www.twingate.com/comparisons/openvpn): How Twingate compares to OpenVPN
- [Twingate vs Perimeter 81](https://www.twingate.com/comparisons/perimeter81): How Twingate compares to Perimeter 81
- [Zscaler Alternatives](https://www.twingate.com/blog/comparisons/zscaler-alternatives): How Twingate compares to Zscaler and other ZTNA options
- [Cloudflare Alternatives](https://www.twingate.com/blog/comparisons/cloudflare-alternatives): How Twingate compares to Cloudflare Access
- [Palo Alto Networks Alternatives](https://www.twingate.com/blog/comparisons/palo-alto-networks-alternatives): How Twingate compares to Palo Alto Prisma Access
- [ZTNA vs VPN](https://www.twingate.com/ztna-vs-vpn): Zero Trust Network Access vs traditional VPNs

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://www.twingate.com/docs): Setup guides, architecture, and API reference
- [Quick Start](https://www.twingate.com/docs/quick-start): Get started with Twingate
- [Architecture](https://www.twingate.com/docs/architecture): How Twingate's network architecture works
- [API Overview](https://www.twingate.com/docs/api-overview): REST and GraphQL API documentation
- [FAQ](https://www.twingate.com/docs/faq): Frequently asked questions

## Integrations
- [AWS](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/aws): Secure access to AWS resources
- [Azure](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/azure): Secure access to Azure environments
- [Google Cloud](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/google-cloud-platform): Secure access to GCP
- [Okta](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/okta): Identity provider integration
- [Azure AD](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/azure-ad): Microsoft Entra ID integration
- [Google Workspace](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/google-workspace): Google identity integration
- [CrowdStrike](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/crowdstrike): Device posture via CrowdStrike Falcon
- [SentinelOne](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/sentinelone): Endpoint security integration
- [Terraform](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/terraform): Infrastructure-as-code provisioning
- [Kubernetes](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/kubernetes): Kubernetes connector deployment
- [Datadog](https://www.twingate.com/integrations/datadog): Log and metrics integration
- [All Integrations](https://www.twingate.com/integrations): Full list of 40+ integrations

## Learn
- [Blog](https://www.twingate.com/blog): Security insights, product updates, and tutorials
- [Glossary](https://www.twingate.com/blog/glossary): 1,300+ cybersecurity and networking terms
- [Comparisons](https://www.twingate.com/blog/comparisons): 275+ security product comparisons
- [Insights](https://www.twingate.com/blog/insights): Insights into cybersecurity, Zero Trust, AI, and more

## Customer Stories
- [Blend](https://www.twingate.com/customers/blend): Fintech company securing remote access
- [Modern Health](https://www.twingate.com/customers/modern-health): Mental health platform
- [Hi-Rez Studios](https://www.twingate.com/customers/hi-rez): Gaming studio — trimmed 73% of unnecessary access
- [H2O.ai](https://www.twingate.com/customers/h2o): AI/ML platform
- [Zappi](https://www.twingate.com/customers/zappi): Consumer insights platform
- [All Customers](https://www.twingate.com/customers): Full customer story collection

## Resources
- [Zero Trust Whitepaper](https://www.twingate.com/resources/zero-trust-wp): Understanding zero trust architecture
- [Security Whitepaper](https://www.twingate.com/resources/twingate-security-whitepaper): Twingate security architecture details
- [IT Leaders Guide to ZTNA](https://www.twingate.com/resources/it-leaders-guide-to-modern-ztna): Guide for IT decision-makers
- [Architecture Diagram](https://www.twingate.com/resources/architecture-diagram): Visual overview of Twingate's architecture

## Company Links
- [About](https://www.twingate.com/about): Company story and mission
- [Careers](https://www.twingate.com/careers): Open positions
- [Partners](https://www.twingate.com/partners): Partner program
- [Startup Program](https://www.twingate.com/startup-program): Free access for qualifying startups
- [Community Hub](https://www.twingate.com/community-hub): Community resources

## Key Technical Facts
- Twingate does not currently use WireGuard. It uses a proprietary encrypted proxy architecture.
- Connectors initiate outbound-only connections to the Twingate Controller — no inbound firewall ports required.
- Access is resource-level (per application or service), not network-level. There is no VPN tunnel.
- Components: Client (user device), Connector (deployed in your network), Controller (Twingate cloud), Relay (fallback TURN-based routing).
- Compatible with any cloud, on-prem, or hybrid environment with no network changes required.
